faq.heading: Questions, Answered
faq.subtext: Straightforward answers to what clients ask us most before booking a consultation.

countries.q: Which countries does KMS Consultants help clients immigrate to?
countries.a: We specialize in immigration pathways to Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the United States, and the European Union — covering skilled migration, study permits, work permits, business residency, permanent residency, and family sponsorship.

location.a: Our headquarters is in Doha, Qatar. We serve clients across Qatar and the wider GCC region, with every service available in both English and Arabic.

services.q: What services does KMS Consultants provide?
services.a: Six core services: Skilled Immigration, Study Permits, Work Permits, Business Residency, Permanent Residency, and Family Sponsorship — each tailored to your destination country's specific requirements.

booking.q: How do I book a consultation?
booking.a: Request a private consultation directly through our booking page, or reach us by phone or email. A senior consultant will follow up to schedule your confidential assessment.

arabic.q: Is your service available in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. Our entire website and consultation process is available in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support for Arabic-speaking clients.

firstStep.q: What's the first step in the immigration process?
firstStep.a: It begins with a confidential eligibility assessment, where we review your profile against your target country's requirements before recommending a tailored pathway.

credentials.q: Is KMS Consultants a licensed and certified immigration consultancy?
credentials.a: Yes. Our team includes MARA-certified agents for Australian immigration and an IRCC-authorized representative for Canadian immigration, giving clients direct access to regulator-recognized expertise for two of our five core destinations.

trackRecord.q: How many clients has KMS Consultants helped, and where are they from?
trackRecord.a: We've handled hundreds of successful immigration cases for more than 1,000 clients from over 20 nationalities across Qatar and the GCC, maintaining a 5-star rating on Google based on post-service client feedback.
